_about: Riot Mode animations for the Riot versions of the Retro band (see source.json). Two big, high-energy loops per musician; the game alternates them every 2 bars while Riot Mode is on. Same rules as the main recipe: 16 frames, start and end on the standing pose. Make with scripts/pixellab/animate.py assets/art/pixellab-retro-riot, pack with fetch_and_pack.py --source assets/art/pixellab-retro-riot/source.json.
